content_data.meeting_title: Regional Airspace Management System Modernization - Technical Working Group Session 3
agenda_items: Progress update on secure data link protocol development for inter-agency communication
Planning for next phase of experimental simulation trials
Review of current system architecture vulnerabilities identified in recent assessments
Discussion on potential AI/ML integration for predictive air traffic flow optimization
Evaluation of proposed sensor data fusion algorithms for enhanced situational awareness
key_decisions: Formulate a sub-committee to investigate quantum-resistant cryptographic solutions for future secure data link protocols.
Prioritize research into explainable AI methodologies for air traffic control applications to ensure regulatory compliance.
Approve the pilot implementation of the new sensor data fusion module in the regional testbed environment within the upcoming period.
attendees: Ms. Anya Sharma (Data Scientist, Predictive Analytics Unit)
Dr. Sofia Ramirez (Aerospace Policy Analyst, Regulatory Affairs)
Mr. David Kim (Systems Integration Lead, Engineering Department)
Dr. Aris Thorne (Lead Research Scientist, AI/ML Division)
Dr. Kai Chen (Principal Investigator, Sensor Fusion Group)
Dr. Lena Petrova (Senior Cryptography Researcher, Cybersecurity Lab)
